description: The coverage manifest — LOAD THIS FIRST (workspace key). For every app it returns which surfaces are instrumented vs a blind spot: coverage.revenue / readCost / analytics / userCensus, each 'measured' or 'not_instrumented'. Use it to interpret every later number: if an app's readCost is 'not_instrumented' here, a blank read-cost for it later is a KNOWN blind spot, not a real zero. Prevents reporting an un-wired surface as fact.
name: get_portfolio
title: Get the portfolio coverage map
